title: 10 Oversold Insurance Stocks to Buy According to Analysts - Insider Monkey
summary: Analysts identify 10 oversold insurance stocks amidst a softening market with slower premium growth, stable ROE, and rising investment rates. Property insurance rates are decreasing, while liability and healthcare costs remain high. Insurers are expected to invest significantly in AI technology. The health insurance industry faces rate increases due to higher consumption and medical costs.
sentiment_reason: The article discusses a shift to a soft market with slower growth and ongoing cost pressures, particularly in the casualty and health insurance sectors, despite some positive developments in property insurance and AI investments.
